comments: Alternative Key Project fit to the original Saha et al. photometry, using the article's stated 44-Cepheid P>18 d sample. This shorter cutoff is more susceptible to incompleteness than the preferred P>25 d fit.

Final ALLFRAME+TRIAL solution from 51 of 94 Cepheids with P>25 d, selected to reduce incompleteness bias. It agrees with the earlier Saha et al. distance; no metallicity correction enters the tabulated modulus.
